description: This file contains selector utility functions for memoization, dependency management, and structured selection in a Redux-based state management system, specifically for Mattermost.

methods.name: defaultEqualityCheck
methods.description: Checks if two values are strictly equal.

methods.name: areArgumentsShallowlyEqual
methods.description: Determines if two argument arrays are shallowly equal based on an equality check.

methods.name: defaultMemoize
methods.description: Creates a memoized version of a function with optional custom equality check.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Retrieves and validates dependencies (selectors) for creating a composite selector.

methods.name: createSelectorCreator
methods.description: Factory function to create custom selector functions with memoization.

methods.name: createStructuredSelector
methods.description: Creates a structured selector that maps state slices to an object.
